deviations.what: t1 step 3 has six statements, not the four in its instruction: two sqlite_sequence statements (DELETE the items_new row, rename the items row to items_new) carry the AUTOINCREMENT high-water mark across the rebuild
deviations.reason: without them the rebuild resets sqlite_sequence to max(id), so an id freed by deleting the highest item would be reused, breaking t1's own criterion 'not a reused id'; guarded by test_rebuild_keeps_the_autoincrement_high_water_mark

deviations.reason: t2 widens core KINDS, and tests/cli/test_nouns.py::test_library_kind_choices_match_the_server requires the CLI tuple to equal it; with the plan's split the suite fails between t2 and t4, which the after-merge test gate forbids
